messages:
ana: Heads-up: planning session for embeddings endpoint behavior next sprint. Customers want 4096 dims, stable per-item shapes for FAISS, and smooth migration from 1024. Can we finalize shape policy + batching limits?

matt: We should require a single dimension per request. Mixing dims in one response breaks most indexers. Two choices: enforce single-dim-per-request OR return per-item dim metadata. I prefer enforce single-dim.

sasha: Agreed. Proposal: server validates and rejects mixed-dim inputs. Support shape_mode: strict|pad|truncate. strict => must match model dim; pad => pad with zeros up to requested dim; truncate => cut.

product_beth: Customers want pad option for compatibility but worried about payload bloat. Could we include a pad_cap to limit padding percentage?

jamal: Ops constraints: set max_items_per_request and max_total_elements (items*dim) to bound GPU memory. Suggest max_items=256 and max_elements=1_048_576 so 256*4096 fits. Public tier default max_items=64. Return 413 if exceeded with split recommendations.

matt: API sketch: POST /v1/embeddings {"model":"rw-embed-4096","inputs":[...],"shape_mode":"strict|pad|truncate","encoding":"json|base64"} Response: {"data":[{"embedding":[...],"dim":"4096"},...],"model":"rw-embed-4096"} Notes: include dim on items for debugging but guarantee uniform dim when strict/pad.

sasha: Binary option (base64 float32) for enterprise customers is good. SDKs should show typed array examples.

product_beth: Rollout: existing clients with no shape_mode keep legacy dim (1024) for a deprecation window. New clients must choose model/dim. Add deprecation warnings in response headers.

jamal: Model mapping: requested_dim -> preferred_model (512,1024,2048,4096). If client requests unsupported dim, return 422 with suggestions. Allow explicit model override but validate.

ana: Cost signal: surface estimated compute cost for the request via X-Emb-Cost-Estimate header for large batches/4096 dims. Also quota gates for big dims.

matt: Need perf matrix (latency/throughput) per model+dim at batch sizes 1/8/32/64. Also include quantization recommendations in Optimize (e.g., q4_0 for 4096).

sasha: Tests: cover strict/pad/truncate, binary encoding, 413 split hint, 422 model-suggestion message, and a FAISS integration to validate indexing.

product_beth: Docs + migration guide: storage/indexing implications and cost. SDKs expose shape_mode and encoding with sane defaults.

jamal: Ops: add per-dim rate limits, memory alerts at 70% on embed nodes, and canary for pad mode to ensure no disk blowup.

ana: Action items: ana -> spec PR (API, error codes, rollout); matt -> perf matrix + validators; sasha -> integration tests + SDK examples; jamal -> quota/rate-limit and alerts; product_beth -> docs + comms. Target: spec merged by EOD Thu, validators next sprint, beta with select customers for 2 weeks.
